p02-night-electrician: When Harvey flooded Houston, six engineers stayed inside the building from Friday to Tuesday, doing the hands-on work for customers who could not get through. The power never went down.
p05-heat-engineer: The warmth a data center makes goes next door. Helsinki homes have been heated this way since 2010, and in 2025, nineteen gigawatt hours of recovered heat went to communities.
p06-cooling-engineer: In water-stressed places we cool with air, not water. Since 2023 the design rules forbid evaporative cooling there, and Madrid’s newest site runs without consuming any water at all.
p04-tour-guide: More than eighteen hundred students came through our doors on tours in 2025. One tour sparked a path from an internship to a full-time technician’s badge in Chicago.
p10-energy-manager: Ninety-six percent renewable coverage, the eighth year above ninety. And in Georgia, we pay every cent of the grid costs our demand creates, for twenty years, so neighbours’ bills do not rise.
p08-volunteer: Colleagues gave more than fifty-four thousand hours in 2025, up forty-five percent. Twenty-eight teams chose and backed thirty-one local nonprofits where they live.
